00_Master_Story_超级母题45秒全景.mp3.text: I'm currently working as a full stack developer at a tech firm. Basically, my day-to-day job involves developing useful applications that make everyday life easier and more convenient for people. It can be quite fast-paced and challenging, but I find it deeply fulfilling. The main reason I chose this path is quite simple I actually majored in computer science back in university. Right after graduation, I joined a tech company, and that was where I crossed paths with an amazing team lead. He noticed that I had a real knack for coding, so he brought me into his core team. Since then, we've shipped quite a few successful projects together, and even picked up several company awards. Looking back, being able to develop useful applications that really help people gives me a huge sense of achievement and pride. So, I genuinely enjoy what I do!
